profile.name: Zach Jacko
profile.headline: Website Development & Security
profile.summary: Website developer and security tester from Wilkes County, North Carolina. I started learning HTML in 2016 and am now working toward a degree in Systems Security, where a web development course pulled me deeper into HTML, CSS, PHP, and MySQL. I build sites, then test them to their true limits - sometimes breaking things along the way, always putting them back together harder to break.

experience.description: Security testing for summitgamingofwilkes.com - probing the site's defenses, documenting findings, and helping harden it against real-world attack paths.
Building websites and breaking them on purpose - development paired with security testing from the first line of code.
Teammate and I placed first in the state competition, then eighth in the United States at the national competition.
